Normalized Heritage (RFI v1.0). Ported to Roll for Initiation: 7-damage-type canon, Soma Break, Tier-based scaling, reroll-lowest. Replaces the D&D5E heritage draft dated 2026-04-19 00:10.

“What you are now is not what you were. The pressure was the point.”

Menhirkin (Metamorphic). Land buried, squeezed, heated, and returned harder. Every Metamorphic has a before-self. You are not going back.

Heritage Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Menhirkin).
  • Size. Medium. Speed: normal.
  • Pressure Remade. At each Soma Break, the day picks one: +1 Guard, +1 Evasion, or +1 Resolve. Roll 1d3 at dawn (1 Guard, 2 Evasion, 3 Resolve), or announce your choice if the GM allows. The bonus holds until your next Soma Break. Ask the GM to apply it on your sheet (any editable defense field).
  • Unbreakable Core. Reroll the lowest die on Resolve checks against forced transformation or being reshaped against your will.
  • Signature. You gain The Thing You Were at character creation.

Engine note. Where this heritage grants a damage-type resistance, it is applied by the fourththing defense engine via flags.fourththing.grants. Narrative immunities (sleep, forced movement, cold iron) are descriptive only until the Phase 3 condition-and-flavor engine ships.

advancement.hint: Gain the Menhirkin (Metamorphic) signature feat: The Thing You Were.
